output.title: BR-04 SEK line amounts at exactly half an öre round half away from zero @critical
output.data_choice: P-1021 bills a SEK customer (C120) at the October rate of 11.47, so EUR line amounts of 139.50 and 325.50 convert to exactly 1,600.065 and 3,733.485 SEK. In both cases the digit before the 5 is even, so banker's rounding (the BILL-1046 defect) would show 1,600.06 and 3,733.48 instead of 1,600.07 and 3,733.49. Note that the material does not confirm that a line's amount is (hours × rate + adjustment) converted at the invoice-date rate; engineers should check this before relying on the expected values.
scenario: Create a proposal for P-1021 Norrsken substation study with period end and invoice date 2026-10-31
Write line 1 up by 0.75 EUR with reason 'Rounding check', taking it from 138.75 to 139.50 EUR
Write line 2 up by 1.75 EUR with reason 'Rounding check', taking it from 323.75 to 325.50 EUR
Read the exchange rate, the line adjustments, the line amounts and the subtotal
Delete the proposal and accept the confirmation
